newsitem.title: FRANCE: Fr.Telecom seeks Global One Asian partner.
newsitem.headline: Fr.Telecom seeks Global One Asian partner.

text.p: France Telecom external affairs director Gerard Moine told a telephone conference that the company was looking for an Asian partner to join the Global One alliance with Deutsche Telekom and Sprint Corp.
He said, in reaction to last weekend's Word Trade Organisation (WTO) pact on telecommunications, that the pact opened up Asian markets to the alliance.
Asked whether NTT of Japan could be a partner, Moine said NTT was a difficult partner because of its size but he did not exclude any potential partner.
